title: Great tour with Antonio
text: The 3 ciudades tour was wonderful. Time was a little short in Cordoba, but visiting 3 cities in 1 day is almost impossible otherwise ha ha. Special mention to Ronda, that we had the pleasure to discover at sunset. We had an amazing time with Antonio, our very informative and sympathetic guide, he was eager to share his knowledge and recommendations.
author: Travel05339171750

title: Thank you Enrique for being the best tour guide.
text: Enrique, our the best tour guide! He is very professional tour guide. His explanation in English was easy to understand and clear. He took care everyone very well.  Our trip from Seville to Ronda was smooth and fun.
author: angelakG7324VF

title: Maraming Salamat Enrique
text: Cordoba, white village and Ronda is a must try if you are going southern part of Spain. Thanks to Enrique who helped us to appreciate the places we visited. He is an energetic, knowledgeable and you can really feel his passion for what he’s doing. He also help me and my friend to secure a last minute booking for Cordoba tickets for that we are very grateful. Gracias! Adios compañero! Maraming Salamat! Vamos!

title: A wonderful one day trip!
text: We had a wonderful day exploring Ronda and Córdoba! A big thank you to Enrique for being such a fantastic guide. He was knowledgeable, friendly and passionate, making the trip both interesting and enjoyable. Everything was well organised, and his stories and insights made the experience even more special. Highly recommended! 😊
author: Jekaterina_V

title: Trip to cordoba, white village and ronda
text: Enrique was excellent and would recommend him to others. Has lots of knowledge and was mindful of everyone’s needs.
author: DebO403

title: Worth the time!
text: Enrique was excellent! He kept us informed, entertained and on schedule. I felt safe riding the bus with our driver. Even though it was a long day, I would not hesitate to book it again. It was a great introduction to the three cities. If contemplating booking, just do it!
author: R1740UJns

title: excellent
text: Antonio is an excellent guide, both for his cultural and historical knowledge and for his ability to connect with and attend to a very diverse group. It was a good mix of historical information and contemporary facts that allows one to glimpse the complexity of this area. Antonio also has a good sense of humor and curiosity, so it was very enjoyable. Everything ran on time and we managed to see more than I thought. It was worth it, and I hope you are lucky enough to have him.
author: K880PZcamillel

title: Great way to see all the highlights of the cities, then decide if you want to come back for more.
text: Very informative.    Lots of history.    Antonio was knowledgeable,  fluent in English and Spanish and no problem understand him.   It’s a long day.   Bring some snacks and eat breakfast before you go.
